primary_metric.name: original_exact_verdict_accuracy
primary_metric.rule: Compare original author_ground_truth and recorded_verdict strings, unchanged.

optional_secondary_metric.name: keep_safe_only_equivalence_sensitivity_analysis
optional_secondary_metric.rule: Map both author and recorded labels through this fixed mapping. No TOMBSTONE/REJECT equivalence. Report alongside the original result, never replace it.
optional_secondary_metric.future_policy_equivalence: Requires an independently specified task rubric; neither label authorizes action.

uncertainty.assumption: Independent binomial sampling from a defined population; not established for the curated twelve historical cases.
uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive conditional intervals only; no claim of product/population/generalization confidence.
uncertainty.auc_interval: NOT_REPORTED; 32 correlated positive-negative pairs are not 32 independent observations.

retrospective_discrimination.negative_class: all other author labels, including REJECT and TOMBSTONE; not certified safe
retrospective_discrimination.auc: Pairwise ROC AUC: one point for higher HOSTILE risk, half for ties; divided by4*8.
retrospective_discrimination.threshold: Posthoc midpoint between largest observed negative score and smallest observed positive score; evaluate on these same twelve rows only.

independent_labeling.labeler: Peter or another person, with prior exposure explicitly disclosed; use a genuinely unexposed independent person if blindness is needed.
packet_required_fields: original option/action definitions and neutral task rubric
packet_excluded_fields: source filenames or identifiers that reveal the answer
independent_labeling.answers_and_label_key_location: Separate operator-retained file; never in the labeler packet.

future_unseen_experiment.use: New unseen held-out cases when available; this historical table stays a development/reference set.
freeze_before_reveal: threshold chosen on a separate development/calibration set
cost ceiling and go if any model call is paid
future_unseen_experiment.training_promotion: NONE; no reference record becomes a verified training example without independent receipt qualification.

missing_raw_provenance: complete raw responses and usage/cost receipts
original locked gen19 prediction and lock evidence
